scaler: StandardScaler fit on training features only; unchanged across permutations
validation: true labels fixed, no threshold selection or tuning
interpretation: conditional algorithmic sensitivity under deliberate row-label randomization, not formal significance testing, independent-campaign inference, or proof of absence of leakage
stopping_rule: Run all scheduled99 attempts once; stop only on input identity/runtime failure. Report failed and nonconverged fits separately, with no seed substitutions or outcome-driven extensions.
